hints.tr: Bir bit önek ağı ikiye, iki bit dörde böler.
hints.en: One prefix bit splits the network in two, two bits in four.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
import ipaddress


def split(cidr, new_prefix):
    net = ipaddress.ip_network(cidr)
    return [str(part) for part in net.subnets(new_prefix=new_prefix)]

for part in split("192.168.1.0/24", 26):
    print(part)
print(len(split("10.0.0.0/16", 24)))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
import ipaddress


def split(cidr, new_prefix):
    net = ipaddress.ip_network(cidr)
    return [str(part) for part in net.subnets(new_prefix=new_prefix)]

for part in split("192.168.1.0/24", 26):
    print(part)
print(len(split("10.0.0.0/16", 24)))
```
